verses.original: דְּבַר־ יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֔ה אֶל־ יוֹאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ פְּתוּאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ă·šer hā·yāh ’el- yō·w·’êl ben- pə·ṯū·’êl
verses.literal: This is the word of the LORD that came to Joel son of Pethuel
verses.literalPt: PALAVRA do SENHOR, que foi dirigida a Joel, filho de Petuel.

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־ זֹאת֙ הַזְּקֵנִ֔ים וְהַֽאֲזִ֔ינוּ כֹּ֖ל יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ הֶהָ֤יְתָה זֹּאת֙ בִּֽימֵיכֶ֔ם וְאִ֖ם בִּימֵ֥י אֲבֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū- zōṯ haz·zə·qê·nîm wə·ha·’ă·zî·nū kōl yō·wō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ he·hā·yə·ṯāh zōṯ bî·mê·ḵem wə·’im bî·mê ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Hear this O elders and give ear all who dwell in the land Has anything like this ever happened in your days or in the days of your fathers
verses.literalPt: Ouvi isto, vós anciãos, e escutai, todos os moradores da terra: Porventura isto aconteceu em vossos dias, ou nos dias de vossos pais?

verses.original: עָלֶ֖יהָ לִבְנֵיכֶ֣ם סַפֵּ֑רוּ וּבְנֵיכֶם֙ לִבְנֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֖ם לְד֥וֹר אַחֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·le·hā liḇ·nê·ḵem sap·pê·rū ū·ḇə·nê·ḵem liḇ·nê·hem ū·ḇə·nê·hem lə·ḏō·wr ’a·ḥêr
verses.literal: Tell it to your children let your children tell it to their children and their children to the next generation
verses.literalPt: Fazei sobre isto uma narração a vossos filhos, e vossos filhos a seus filhos, e os filhos destes à outra geração.

verses.original: יֶ֤תֶר הַגָּזָם֙ אָכַ֣ל הָֽאַרְבֶּ֔ה וְיֶ֥תֶר הָאַרְבֶּ֖ה אָכַ֣ל הַיָּ֑לֶק וְיֶ֣תֶר הַיֶּ֔לֶק אָכַ֖ל הֶחָסִֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: ye·ṯer hag·gā·zām ’ā·ḵal hā·’ar·beh wə·ye·ṯer hā·’ar·beh ’ā·ḵal hay·yā·leq wə·ye·ṯer hay·ye·leq ’ā·ḵal he·ḥā·sîl
verses.literal: What the devouring locust has left the swarming locust has eaten what the swarming locust has left the young locust has eaten and what the young locust has left the destroying locust has eaten
verses.literalPt: O que ficou da lagarta, o gafanhoto o comeu, e o que ficou do gafanhoto, a locusta o comeu, e o que ficou da locusta, o pulgão o comeu.

verses.original: הָקִ֤יצוּ שִׁכּוֹרִים֙ וּבְכ֔וּ וְהֵילִ֖לוּ כָּל־ שֹׁ֣תֵי יָ֑יִן עַל־ עָסִ֕יס כִּ֥י נִכְרַ֖ת מִפִּיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·qî·ṣū šik·kō·w·rîm ū·ḇə·ḵū wə·hê·li·lū kāl- šō·ṯê yā·yin ‘al- ‘ā·sîs kî niḵ·raṯ mip·pî·ḵem
verses.literal: Wake up you drunkards and weep wail all you drinkers of wine because of the sweet wine for it has been cut off from your mouth
verses.literalPt: Despertai-vos, bêbados, e chorai; gemei, todos os que bebeis vinho, por causa do mosto, porque tirado é da vossa boca.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ גוֹי֙ עָלָ֣ה עַל־ אַרְצִ֔י עָצ֖וּם וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר שִׁנָּיו֙ שִׁנֵּ֣י אַרְיֵ֔ה וּֽמְתַלְּע֥וֹת לָבִ֖יא לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḡō·w ‘ā·lāh ‘al- ’ar·ṣî ‘ā·ṣūm wə·’ên mis·pār šin·nāw šin·nê ’ar·yêh ū·mə·ṯal·lə·‘ō·wṯ lā·ḇî lōw
verses.literal: For a nation has invaded . . . My land powerful and without number its teeth are the teeth of a lion and its fangs are the fangs of a lioness
verses.literalPt: Porque subiu contra a minha terra uma nação poderosa e sem número; os seus dentes são dentes de leão, e têm queixadas de um leão velho.

verses.original: שָׂ֤ם גַּפְנִי֙ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה וּתְאֵנָתִ֖י לִקְצָפָ֑ה חָשֹׂ֤ף חֲשָׂפָהּ֙ וְהִשְׁלִ֔יךְ הִלְבִּ֖ינוּ שָׂרִיגֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: śām gap̄·nî lə·šam·māh ū·ṯə·’ê·nā·ṯî liq·ṣā·p̄āh ḥā·śōp̄ ḥă·śā·p̄āh wə·hiš·lîḵ hil·bî·nū śā·rî·ḡe·hā
verses.literal: It has laid waste My grapevine and splintered My fig tree It has stripped off the bark . . . and thrown it away the branches have turned white
verses.literalPt: Fez da minha vide uma assolação, e tirou a casca da minha figueira; despiu-a toda, e a lançou por terra; os seus sarmentos se embranqueceram.

verses.original: אֱלִ֕י כִּבְתוּלָ֥ה חֲגֻֽרַת־ שַׂ֖ק עַל־ בַּ֥עַל נְעוּרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lî kiḇ·ṯū·lāh ḥă·ḡu·raṯ- śaq ‘al- ba·‘al nə·‘ū·re·hā
verses.literal: Wail like a virgin dressed in sackcloth grieving for the husband of her youth
verses.literalPt: Lamenta como a virgem que está cingida de saco, pelo marido da sua mocidade.

verses.original: הָכְרַ֥ת מִנְחָ֛ה וָנֶ֖סֶךְ מִבֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אָֽבְלוּ֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḵə·raṯ min·ḥāh wā·ne·seḵ mib·bêṯ Yah·weh ’ā·ḇə·lū hak·kō·hă·nîm mə·šā·rə·ṯê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Grain and drink offerings . . . have been cut off from the house of the LORD the priests are in mourning those who minister before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Foi cortada a oferta de alimentos e a libação da casa do SENHOR; os sacerdotes, ministros do SENHOR, estão entristecidos.

verses.original: שֻׁדַּ֣ד שָׂדֶ֔ה אָבְלָ֖ה אֲדָמָ֑ה כִּ֚י שֻׁדַּ֣ד דָּגָ֔ן הוֹבִ֥ישׁ תִּיר֖וֹשׁ אֻמְלַ֥ל יִצְהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: šud·daḏ śā·ḏeh ’ā·ḇə·lāh ’ă·ḏā·māh kî šud·daḏ dā·ḡān hō·w·ḇîš tî·rō·wōš ’um·lal yiṣ·hār
verses.literal: The field is ruined the land mourns For the grain is destroyed the new wine . . . is dried up and the oil fails
verses.literalPt: O campo está assolado, e a terra triste; porque o trigo está destruído, o mosto se secou, o azeite acabou.

verses.original: הֹבִ֣ישׁוּ אִכָּרִ֗ים הֵילִ֙ילוּ֙ כֹּֽרְמִ֔ים עַל־ חִטָּ֖ה וְעַל־ שְׂעֹרָ֑ה כִּ֥י אָבַ֖ד קְצִ֥יר שָׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hō·ḇî·šū ’ik·kā·rîm hê·lî·lū kō·rə·mîm ‘al- ḥiṭ·ṭāh wə·‘al- śə·‘ō·rāh kî ’ā·ḇaḏ qə·ṣîr śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: Be dismayed O farmers wail O vinedressers over the wheat and barley because the harvest of the field has perished
verses.literalPt: Envergonhai-vos, lavradores, gemei, vinhateiros, sobre o trigo e a cevada; porque a colheita do campo pereceu.

verses.original: הַגֶּ֣פֶן הוֹבִ֔ישָׁה וְהַתְּאֵנָ֖ה אֻמְלָ֑לָה רִמּ֞וֹן גַּם־ תָּמָ֣ר וְתַפּ֗וּחַ כָּל־ עֲצֵ֤י הַשָּׂדֶה֙ יָבֵ֔שׁוּ כִּֽי־ הֹבִ֥ישׁ שָׂשׂ֖וֹן מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: hag·ge·p̄en hō·w·ḇî·šāh wə·hat·tə·’ê·nāh ’um·lā·lāh rim·mō·wn gam- tā·mār wə·ṯap·pū·aḥ kāl- ‘ă·ṣê haś·śā·ḏeh yā·ḇê·šū kî- hō·ḇîš śā·śō·wn min- bə·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: The grapevine is dried up and the fig tree is withered the pomegranate . . . palm and apple all the trees of the orchard are withered Surely the joy of mankind has dried up
verses.literalPt: A vide se secou, a figueira se murchou, a romeira também, e a palmeira e a macieira; todas as árvores do campo se secaram, e já não há alegria entre os filhos dos homens.

verses.original: חִגְר֨וּ וְסִפְד֜וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים הֵילִ֙ילוּ֙ מְשָׁרְתֵ֣י מִזְבֵּ֔חַ בֹּ֚אוּ לִ֣ינוּ בַשַּׂקִּ֔ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֖י אֱלֹהָ֑י כִּ֥י נִמְנַ֛ע מִבֵּ֥ית אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם מִנְחָ֥ה וָנָֽסֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥiḡ·rū wə·sip̄·ḏū hak·kō·hă·nîm hê·lî·lū mə·šā·rə·ṯê miz·bê·aḥ bō·’ū lî·nū ḇaś·śaq·qîm mə·šā·rə·ṯê ’ĕ·lō·hāy kî nim·na‘ mib·bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem min·ḥāh wā·nā·seḵ
verses.literal: Put on sackcloth and lament O priests wail O ministers of the altar Come spend the night in sackcloth O ministers of my God because the grain and drink offerings are withheld from the house of your God
verses.literalPt: Cingi-vos e lamentai-vos, sacerdotes; gemei, ministros do altar; entrai e passai a noite vestidos de saco, ministros do meu Deus; porque a oferta de alimentos, e a libação, foram cortadas da casa de vosso Deus.

verses.original: קַדְּשׁוּ־ צוֹם֙ קִרְא֣וּ עֲצָרָ֔ה אִסְפ֣וּ זְקֵנִ֗ים כֹּ֚ל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְזַעֲק֖וּ אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qad·də·šū- ṣō·wm qir·’ū ‘ă·ṣā·rāh ’is·p̄ū zə·qê·nîm kōl yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ bêṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·za·‘ă·qū ’el- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Consecrate a fast proclaim a solemn assembly Gather the elders and all the residents of the land to the house of the LORD your God and cry out to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Santificai um jejum, convocai uma assembléia solene, congregai os anciãos, e todos os moradores desta terra, na casa do SENHOR vosso Deus, e clamai ao SENHOR.

verses.original: אֲהָ֖הּ לַיּ֑וֹם כִּ֤י קָרוֹב֙ י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה וּכְשֹׁ֖ד מִשַׁדַּ֥י יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·hāh lay·yō·wm kî qā·rō·wḇ yō·wm Yah·weh ū·ḵə·šōḏ mi·šad·day yā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: Alas for the day For the Day of the LORD is near and it will come as destruction from the Almighty
verses.literalPt: Ai do dia! Porque o dia do SENHOR está perto, e virá como uma assolação do Todo-Poderoso.

verses.original: הֲל֛וֹא נֶ֥גֶד עֵינֵ֖ינוּ אֹ֣כֶל נִכְרָ֑ת מִבֵּ֥ית אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ שִׂמְחָ֥ה וָגִֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ne·ḡeḏ ‘ê·nê·nū ’ō·ḵel niḵ·rāṯ mib·bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū śim·ḥāh wā·ḡîl
verses.literal: Has not the food been cut off before our very eyes joy and gladness from the house of our God
verses.literalPt: Porventura o mantimento não está cortado de diante de nossos olhos, a alegria e o regozijo da casa de nosso Deus?

verses.original: עָבְשׁ֣וּ פְרֻד֗וֹת תַּ֚חַת מֶגְרְפֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם נָשַׁ֙מּוּ֙ אֹֽצָר֔וֹת נֶהֶרְס֖וּ מַמְּגֻר֑וֹת כִּ֥י הֹבִ֖ישׁ דָּגָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ḇə·šū p̄ə·ru·ḏō·wṯ ta·ḥaṯ meḡ·rə·p̄ō·ṯê·hem nā·šam·mū ’ō·ṣā·rō·wṯ ne·her·sū mam·mə·ḡu·rō·wṯ kî hō·ḇîš dā·ḡān
verses.literal: The seeds lie shriveled beneath the clods the storehouses are in ruins the granaries are broken down for the grain has withered away
verses.literalPt: As sementes apodreceram debaixo dos seus torrões, os celeiros foram assolados, os armazéns derrubados, porque se secou o trigo.

verses.original: מַה־ נֶּאֶנְחָ֣ה בְהֵמָ֗ה נָבֹ֙כוּ֙ עֶדְרֵ֣י בָקָ֔ר כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין מִרְעֶ֖ה לָהֶ֑ם גַּם־ עֶדְרֵ֥י הַצֹּ֖אן נֶאְשָֽׁמוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mah- ne·’en·ḥāh ḇə·hê·māh nā·ḇō·ḵū ‘eḏ·rê ḇā·qār kî ’ên mir·‘eh lā·hem gam- ‘eḏ·rê haṣ·ṣōn ne’·šā·mū
verses.literal: How the cattle groan The herds . . . wander in confusion because they have no pasture . . . Even the flocks of sheep are suffering
verses.literalPt: Como geme o animal! As manadas de gados estão confusas, porque não têm pasto; também os rebanhos de ovelhas estão perecendo.

verses.original: אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְהוָ֖ה אֶקְרָ֑א כִּ֣י אֵ֗שׁ אָֽכְלָה֙ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֔ר וְלֶ֣הָבָ֔ה לִהֲטָ֖ה כָּל־ עֲצֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·le·ḵā Yah·weh ’eq·rā kî ’êš ’ā·ḵə·lāh nə·’ō·wṯ miḏ·bār wə·le·hā·ḇāh li·hă·ṭāh kāl- ‘ă·ṣê haś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: To You O LORD I call for fire has consumed the open pastures and flames have scorched all the trees of the field
verses.literalPt: A ti, ó SENHOR, clamo, porque o fogo consumiu os pastos do deserto, e a chama abrasou todas as árvores do campo.

verses.original: גַּם־ בַּהֲמ֥וֹת שָׂדֶ֖ה תַּעֲר֣וֹג אֵלֶ֑יךָ כִּ֤י יָֽבְשׁוּ֙ אֲפִ֣יקֵי מָ֔יִם וְאֵ֕שׁ אָכְלָ֖ה נְא֥וֹת הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: gam- ba·hă·mō·wṯ śā·ḏeh ta·‘ă·rō·wḡ ’ê·le·ḵā kî yā·ḇə·šū ’ă·p̄î·qê mā·yim wə·’êš ’ā·ḵə·lāh nə·’ō·wṯ ham·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: Even the beasts of the field pant for You for the streams of water have dried up and fire has consumed the open pastures
verses.literalPt: Também todos os animais do campo bramam a ti; porque as correntes de água se secaram, e o fogo consumiu os pastos do deserto.
